name: Opacity Pruning
definition: A simple opacity-based pruning strategy for general learning. If a mask is provided, a visible mask is calculated to prune Gaussians projected onto masked pixels. Depth can also be used to prune Gaussians in free space or control density according to distance.
summary: Opacity Pruning removes low-opacity Gaussian primitives to eliminate floaters, distinguished by relying solely on opacity magnitude rather than optimization gradients.
